result.Method of Attack: Unauthenticated local WebSocket server allowing remote command execution via browser-initiated WebSocket connections to localhost; Command injection through MCP-formatted JSON-RPC 2.0 messages; Reading local files and executing code in Jupyter notebooks within the IDE
result.Impacted Systems: Claude Code extensions for VS Code and other IDEs (versions 1.0.23 and earlier)
result.Attack Vector: Browser-based exploitation via malicious websites connecting to unauthenticated localhost WebSocket servers; Cross-site WebSocket connections bypassing same-origin policy; Dynamic port brute forcing to discover active MCP server ports
result.Indicators of Compromise: Connections to ws://localhost:<dynamic port> (e.g., ws://localhost:42603); MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 commands such as ping, tools/list, tools/call; Reading sensitive files like /etc/passwd or AWS credential files
